subject: Scheduling window: AIOps discovery + infra procurement alignment
messages:
From: Chris Lowry <chris.lowry@hegebrook.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@hegebrook.com>, procurement@hegebrook.com
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + scheduling: AIOps discovery (eng + procurement + security)

Hi Rafael —

Thanks for the intro. We're excited to explore Redwood for some inference cost & latency optimizations in our AIOps pipelines. Priya (eng lead) and our procurement inbox are looped in here — we'd like to do a 45-minute discovery that includes:
- quick infra overview (Priya)
- procurement timeline & contracting constraints (procurement)
- a short demo / technical Q&A with your SE

Constraints: Priya is in PST and prefers mornings this week; procurement needs a heads-up 72 hours prior for any legal/finance pre-reads. Can you propose 2–3 slots? Also, we need SOC2 details and a short list of what evidence you'll bring.

—Chris

Attachments: none
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
To: Chris Lowry <chris.lowry@hegebrook.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, Priya Menon <priya.m@hegebrook.com>, procurement@hegebrook.com
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + scheduling: AIOps discovery (eng + procurement + security)

Hi Chris — great to meet you and thanks for the context.

We can absolutely run a 45-minute session that covers infra + demo + procurement touchpoints. Quick proposal of slots (all PST):
- Tue 21 Feb, 09:00–09:45
- Tue 21 Feb, 11:00–11:45
- Wed 22 Feb, 10:30–11:15

If none of those work, send a couple alternatives and we'll triage.

What we'll bring:
- 10–12 minute focused demo of the inference runtime for AIOps (SE-led)
- short performance profile examples for similar workloads
- draft mutual action plan and contracting milestones
- SOC 2 summary and what to expect post-evaluation

I've attached a short prep checklist for the call to help the procurement/legal team understand timing and what we need in advance.

Attachments: Redwood_demo_prep_checklist.pdf

Thanks — looping in Marissa (AE) to help with commercial/contract questions and Soojin (SE) for the demo.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0129
From: Priya Menon <priya.m@hegebrook.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, procurement@hegebrook.com, soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Hi all — thanks Rafael.

Quick constraints from my side: mornings between 08:30–11:30 PST are best. Wed 10:30 is ok but I have a standing ops review at 11:30 so please confirm end time. Also: our security lead wants the SOC2 summary + a one-page data handling note at least 72 hours before the call. Can you confirm you'll share that?

Prefer Tue 21 at 09:00 if procurement can make it; otherwise Wed 10:30 works but I may need to drop 5–10 minutes early.

Thanks — Priya
Engineering Lead, AIOps
HedgeBrook Capital

Hi Chris & Priya —

Thanks for the options. We've tentatively booked Tue 21 Feb, 09:00–09:45 PST on the calendar. Please accept if that works. Agenda (45 min):
1) Intros & success criteria (5 min)
2) Infra & data flow (Priya) (10 min)
3) Focused Redwood demo — SE-led (20 min)
4) Procurement/cliffnotes & next steps (10 min)

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan draft and our security summary (SOC2 executive). Rafael / Soojin will send a short data-handling note (one-pager) and the security questionnaire before EOD today to meet the 72-hour ask.

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.docx; Security_Questionnaire_HedgeBrook.xlsx

Calendly / join link: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo — I've set the event and will update with the Zoom link once confirmed.

If procurement needs a different approval path, please flag and we'll route to legal.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (646) 555-0182

If Wed won't work, propose an afternoon slot Thurs. Appreciate the quick turnaround — we want legal comfortable before the commercial discussion.

—Chris
